Daily briefing

30-09-2026 / Comics business and platforms

01 / Opportunity

'Assiégés T3 : Monaco' revisits forgotten historical siege in graphic novel

'Assiégés T3 : Monaco' recounts Monaco's 1506-1507 siege by Genoese forces, blending authentic history with narrative tension. The graphic novel underwent extended development and merges two volumes into one, featuring detailed research by noted medieval historians and showcasing the strategic importance of Monaco's past.

Why it matters to Komotic: This historical graphic novel's scholarly foundation and unique setting could inspire new ways to approach localised historical narratives, opening opportunities for educational comics and niche thematic targeting in our platform.
